Great video! Based on my experience, everything is working as intended and with the expected proficiency. 

However, the task you are requesting from the Comic Strip is too demanding. You need more agents for this. You could create one agent named "Comic Strip Illustrator" that takes the raw images and builds the actual comic strip. This agent should have access only to the code interpreter (Python) and its job is to first use Python to write the text inside the balloons. Then, it would merge the three images with text into a single strip.


A second agent, also called "Comic Strip Illustrator" but with access to DALL-E, would specialize in creating the image and passing it to the "Comic Strip Finisher." The input here would be a description of the image and the output would be the image itself, along with the text to be put in the balloons. This agent will ensure that the balloons are empty and ready to receive the text.

The first agent would be the "Comic Strip Agent" that thinks deeply about the situation, creates the 'joke', 'punch line', etc., and passes the instructions to the "Comic Strip Illustrator."

Is this kind of functionality already possible with the current OpenAI GPT framework? I know it is possible with the 'Assistants' framework.
